function.name: bloodcell_classification
function.description: Identify and categorize different types of blood cells based on given attributes. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

cell_shape.description: The shape of the cell, e.g. round, oval.

cell_size.description: The size of the cell, e.g. large, medium, small.

cell_function.description: The function of the cell, e.g. carrying oxygen, fighting infection. Default: 'carry oxygen'.

message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "What is the name of the type of cells with multiple nuclei?" They want the classification of cells with multiple nuclei. We can use the tool bloodcell_classification. Provide arguments: cell_shape, cell_size, maybe cell_function. But we need to identify and categorize different types of blood cells based on given attributes. The question: "什麼是具有多個細胞核的細胞類型的名稱？" Means "What is the name of the type of cells with multiple nuclei?" So we should classify based on attributes: shape? size? function? The question doesn't provide attributes; they just ask what type of cells have multiple nuclei. That refers to multinucleated cells like osteoclasts or skeletal muscle fibers (myocytes). In blood context, maybe giant platelets? Actually blood cells with multiple nuclei include megakaryocytes produce platelets. Also some white blood cells like neutrophils have multi-lobed nucleus but not multiple separate nuclei. So answer: multinucleated cells called syncytia or myoblasts differentiate into multinucleated myotubes. But the tool expects shape, size, function. We could call it "multinucleated giant cells" like osteoclasts. Let's respond using the tool: Provide shape: irregular, size: large, function: bone resorption. Use default function if omitted. We'll call it "osteoclast".
